SELECT cls,
       CAST(fish_date_doy/30 AS INT) AS month_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS n_trips,
       SUM(anglers) AS anglers,
       SUM(yt) AS yt,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2
GROUP BY cls, month_bucket
ORDER BY month_bucket, cls

SELECT index_id, avail_doy, value
FROM climate
WHERE avail_season = 2
ORDER BY index_id, avail_doy
